title: AS2 compiler: no overflow diagnostics for UI16/SI16 limits (constant pool, DefineFunction2 size, jump offsets)
description: Implemented in packages/core/src/as2/compiler.ts. Added CompileError (exported from @flash/core) carrying source line. Constant pool now caps at the UI16 payload budget (buildConstantPool) and pushString inlines the overflow (graceful, matches real Flash) instead of wrapping the count/length. DefineFunction2 codeSize/numParams/header, ActionWith/ActionTry body sizes, and ActionIf/ActionJump SI16 branch offsets now throw a clear CompileError with the offending source line instead of wrapping mod 65536. writeUI16 gained a backstop range check; patchSI16 range-checks jump offsets. The three generic 'Unsupported ...' throws (expr node / compound-assign / binary op) are now CompileError. Tests: as2/__tests__/overflow-diagnostics.test.ts (5 cases: codeSize overflow, SI16 jump overflow, pool cap+inline, source-line propagation, in-range control). VERIFY: full ordered 'pnpm --filter ./packages/** build' exit 0; '@flash/core' test 5696 passed / 8 skipped (incl. new file). Docs: docs/12-actionscript.md Implementation notes.
